description: This Java class acts as a factory for selecting the appropriate LoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor based on a transaction processing strategy. It includes logic to determine the processor, handle cases where no matching processor is found, and retrieve available strategies.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessorFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for selecting and managing different loan repayment transaction processors based on strategy.

methods.name: determineProcessor
methods.description: Selects the appropriate LoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor based on the provided strategy name, throwing exception if not found and configured to fail.

methods.name: getStrategies
methods.description: Returns a list of TransactionProcessingStrategyData objects representing available transaction processors.
